name: acolyte
flavor: You devoted yourself to service in a temple, either nestled in a town or secluded in a sacred grove. There you performed rites in honor of a god or pantheon. You served under a priest and studied religion. Thanks to your priest's instruction and your own devotion, you also learned how to channel a modicum of divine power in service to your place of worship and the people who prayed there.
equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Calligrapher’s Supplies, Book (prayers), Holy Symbol, Parchment (10 sheets), Robe, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP
flavor_tr: Bir tapınakta hizmete adandınız; orada bir tanrı ya da pantheon onuruna ayinler gerçekleştirdiniz. Rahipinizin rehberliği ve kendi bağlılığınız sayesinde ilahi gücü kanalize etmeyi öğrendiniz.
equipment_tr: A veya B seçin: (A) Hattat Gereçleri, Kitap (dualar), Kutsal Sembol, Parşömen (10 yaprak), Cüppe, 8 AP; veya (B) 50 AP

name: artisan
flavor: Once you were old enough to order an ale, you soon had a favorite stool in every tavern within ten miles of where you were born. As you traveled the circuit from public house to watering hole, you learned to prey on unfortunates who were in the market for a comforting lie or two—perhaps a sham potion or forged ancestry records.
equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Forgery Kit, Costume, Fine Clothes, 15 GP; or (B) 50 GP
flavor_tr: Yıllarca tavernadan tavernaya dolaşarak çeşitli hilelerle geçimini sağladınız; rahat bir yalana ya da sahte bir iksire ihtiyaç duyan talihsizleri avladınız.
equipment_tr: A veya B seçin: (A) Sahtecilik Seti, Kostüm, Güzel Giysiler, 15 AP; veya (B) 50 AP

name: criminal
flavor: You eked out a living in dark alleyways, cutting purses or burgling shops. Perhaps you were part of a small gang of like-minded wrongdoers who looked out for each other. Or maybe you were a lone wolf, fending for yourself against the local thieves' guild and more fearsome lawbreakers.
equipment: Choose A or B: (A) 2 Daggers, Thieves' Tools, Crowbar, 2 Pouches, Traveler's Clothes, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP
flavor_tr: Karanlık arka sokaklarda yaşadınız; kese kestiniz ya da dükkanları soydunuz. Belki küçük bir çetenin parçasıydınız ya da yalnız kurt olarak hayatta kaldınız.
equipment_tr: A veya B seçin: (A) 2 Hançer, Hırsız Aletleri, Levye, 2 Kese, Gezgin Kıyafetleri, 16 AP; veya (B) 50 AP

name: entertainer
flavor: You spent much of your youth following roving fairs and carnivals, performing odd jobs for musicians and acrobats in exchange for lessons. You may have learned how to walk a tightrope, how to play a lute in a distinct style, or how to recite poetry with impeccable diction. To this day, you thrive on applause and long for the stage.
tool: Choose one kind of Musical Instrument
equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Musical Instrument (same as above), 2 Costumes, Mirror, Perfume, Traveler’s Clothes, 11 GP; or (B) 50 GP
flavor_tr: Gençliğinizin büyük bölümünü gezici fuarlarda geçirdiniz; müzisyen ve akrobatlardan dersler karşılığında iş yaptınız. Bugün hâlâ alkışa muhtaç ve sahneyi özlüyorsunuz.
equipment_tr: A veya B seçin: (A) Müzik Aleti, 2 Kostüm, Ayna, Parfüm, Gezgin Kıyafetleri, 11 AP; veya (B) 50 AP

name: farmer
flavor: You grew up close to the land. Years tending animals and cultivating the earth rewarded you with patience and good health. You have a keen appreciation for nature’s bounty alongside a healthy respect for nature's wrath.
equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Sickle, Carpenter's Tools, Healer's Kit, Iron Pot, Shovel, Traveler's Clothes, 30 GP; or (B) 50 GP
flavor_tr: Toprağa yakın büyüdünüz. Hayvanlar ve tarım ile geçen yıllar size sabır ve sağlık kazandırdı. Doğanın lütuf ve gazabına derin bir saygı duyuyorsunuz.
equipment_tr: A veya B seçin: (A) Orak, Marangoz Aletleri, Şifacı Çantası, Demir Tencere, Kürek, Gezgin Kıyafetleri, 30 AP; veya (B) 50 AP

name: guard
flavor: Your feet ache when you remember the countless hours you spent at your post in the tower. You were trained to keep one eye looking outside the wall, watching for marauders sweeping from the nearby forest, and your other eye looking inside the wall, searching for cutpurses and troublemakers.
tool: Choose one kind of Gaming Set
equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Spear, Light Crossbow, 20 Bolts, Gaming Set (same as above), Hooded Lantern, Manacles, Quiver, Traveler’s Clothes, 12 GP; or (B) 50 GP
flavor_tr: Kulede sayısız saat nöbet tutmakla geçirdiniz; bir gözünüzle çevreden, öbür gözünüzle içeriden gelecek tehditlere baktınız.
equipment_tr: A veya B seçin: (A) Mızrak, El Yayı, 20 Ok, Oyun Seti, Kapüşonlu Fener, Kelepçe, Ok Sadağı, Gezgin Kıyafetleri, 12 AP; veya (B) 50 AP

name: guide
flavor: You came of age outdoors, far from settled lands. Your home was anywhere you chose to spread your bedroll. There are wonders in the wilderness— strange monsters, pristine forests and streams, overgrown ruins of great halls once trod by giants— and you learned to fend for yourself as you explored them. From time to time, you guided friendly nature priests who instructed you in the fundamentals of channeling the magic of the wild.
equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Shortbow, 20 Arrows, Cartographer’s Tools, Bedroll, Quiver, Tent, Traveler's Clothes, 3 GP; or (B) 50 GP
flavor_tr: Yerleşim yerlerinden uzakta, doğada büyüdünüz. Vahşi doğanın harikalarını keşfettiniz ve doğa rahiplerine rehberlik ederek kanalın büyüsünün temellerini öğrendiniz.
equipment_tr: A veya B seçin: (A) Kısa Yay, 20 Ok, Kartografya Aletleri, Uyku Tulumu, Ok Sadağı, Çadır, Gezgin Kıyafetleri, 3 AP; veya (B) 50 AP

name: hermit
flavor: You spent your early years secluded in a hut or monastery located well beyond the outskirts of the nearest settlement. In those days, your only companions were the creatures of the forest and those who would occasionally visit to bring news of the outside world and supplies. The solitude allowed you to spend many hours pondering the mysteries of creation.
equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Quarterstaff, Herbalism Kit, Bedroll, Book (philosophy), Lamp, Oil (3 flasks), Traveler's Clothes, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP
flavor_tr: Erken yıllarınızı en yakın yerleşim yerinin dışında bir kulübede ya da manastırda yalnız geçirdiniz. Yalnızlık size yaratılışın sırlarını düşünmek için bol zaman tanıdı.
equipment_tr: A veya B seçin: (A) Asa, Şifalı Bitki Seti, Uyku Tulumu, Kitap (felsefe), Lamba, Yağ (3 şişe), Gezgin Kıyafetleri, 16 AP; veya (B) 50 AP

name: merchant
flavor: You were apprenticed to a trader, caravan master, or shopkeeper, learning the fundamentals of commerce. You traveled broadly, and you earned a living by buying and selling the raw materials artisans need to practice their craft or finished works from such crafters. You might have transported goods from one place to another (by ship, wagon, or caravan) or bought them from traveling traders and sold them in your own shop.
equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Navigator’s Tools, 2 Pouches, Traveler's Clothes, 22 GP; or (B) 50 GP
flavor_tr: Bir tüccar ya da kervan başı yanında çıraklık yaparak ticaretin temellerini öğrendiniz. Geniş çevrelerde dolaştınız ve ham madde ile işlenmiş ürün alıp sattınız.
equipment_tr: A veya B seçin: (A) Denizcinin Aletleri, 2 Kese, Gezgin Kıyafetleri, 22 AP; veya (B) 50 AP

name: noble
flavor: You were raised in a castle, surrounded by wealth, power, and privilege. Your family of minor aristocrats ensured that you received a first-class education, some of which you appreciated and some of which you resented. Your time in the castle, especially the many hours you spent observing your family at court, also taught you a great deal about leadership.
tool: Choose one kind of Gaming Set
equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Gaming Set (same as above), Fine Clothes, Perfume, 29 GP; or (B) 50 GP
flavor_tr: Zenginlik, güç ve ayrıcalık içinde büyüdünüz. Ailenizdeki aristokratlar size birinci sınıf bir eğitim sağladı; saraydaki gözlemleriniz liderlik konusunda size çok şey öğretti.
equipment_tr: A veya B seçin: (A) Oyun Seti, Güzel Giysiler, Parfüm, 29 AP; veya (B) 50 AP

name: sage
flavor: You spent your formative years traveling between manors and monasteries, performing various odd jobs and services in exchange for access to their libraries. You whiled away many a long evening studying books and scrolls, learning the lore of the multiverse - even the rudiments of magic - and your mind yearns for more.
equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Quarterstaff, Calligrapher's Supplies, Book (history), Parchment (8 sheets), Robe, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP
flavor_tr: Gençliğinizi manorlar ve manastırlar arasında dolaşarak geçirdiniz; kütüphanelerine erişim karşılığında çeşitli işler yaptınız. Uzun geceleri kitaplar ve tomarlar arasında geçirerek evrenin sırlarını öğrendiniz.
equipment_tr: A veya B seçin: (A) Asa, Hattat Gereçleri, Kitap (tarih), Parşömen (8 yaprak), Cüppe, 8 AP; veya (B) 50 AP

name: sailor
flavor: You lived as a seafarer, wind at your back and decks swaying beneath your feet. You've perched on barstools in more ports of call than you can remember, faced mighty storms, and swapped stories with folk who live beneath the waves.
equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Dagger, Navigator's Tools, Rope, Traveler's Clothes, 20 GP; or (B) 50 GP
flavor_tr: Bir denizci olarak yaşadınız; sırtınızda rüzgar, ayaklarınızın altında sallanan güverte. Şiddetli fırtınalarla yüzleştiniz ve denizin derinliklerinde yaşayanlarla hikayeler paylaştınız.
equipment_tr: A veya B seçin: (A) Hançer, Denizcinin Aletleri, İp, Gezgin Kıyafetleri, 20 AP; veya (B) 50 AP

name: scribe
flavor: You spent formative years in a scriptorium, a monastery dedicated to the preservation of knowledge, or a government agency, where you learned to write with a clear hand and produce finely written texts. Perhaps you scribed government documents or copied tomes of literature. You might have some skill as a writer of poetry, narrative, or scholarly research. Above all, you have a careful attention to detail, helping you avoid introducing mistakes to the documents you copy and create.
equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Calligrapher’s Supplies, Fine Clothes, Lamp, Oil (3 flasks), Parchment (12 sheets), 23 GP; or (B) 50 GP
flavor_tr: Bilgiyi korumaya adanmış bir scriptorium'da ya da devlet dairesinde çalıştınız; temiz bir el yazısı geliştirdiniz ve ayrıntılara özen göstermeyi öğrendiniz.
equipment_tr: A veya B seçin: (A) Hattat Gereçleri, Güzel Giysiler, Lamba, Yağ (3 şişe), Parşömen (12 yaprak), 23 AP; veya (B) 50 AP

name: soldier
flavor: You began training for war as soon as you reached adulthood and carry precious few memories of life before you took up arms. Battle is in your blood. Sometimes you catch yourself reflexively performing the basic fighting exercises you learned first. Eventually, you put that training to use on the battlefield, protecting the realm by waging war.
tool: Choose one kind of Gaming Set
equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Spear, Shortbow, 20 Arrows, Gaming Set (same as above), Healer's Kit, Quiver, Traveler’s Clothes, 14 GP; or (B) 50 GP
flavor_tr: Yetişkinliğe ulaşır ulaşmaz savaş eğitimi almaya başladınız. Savaş kanınızda akar; temel dövüş alıştırmalarını bilinçsizce yaparken kendinizi bulursunuz.
equipment_tr: A veya B seçin: (A) Mızrak, Kısa Yay, 20 Ok, Oyun Seti, Şifacı Çantası, Ok Sadağı, Gezgin Kıyafetleri, 14 AP; veya (B) 50 AP

name: wayfarer
flavor: You grew up on the streets surrounded by similarly ill-fated castoffs, a few of them friends and a few of them rivals. You slept where you could and did odd jobs for food. At times, when the hunger became unbearable, you resorted to theft. Still, you never lost your pride and never abandoned hope. Fate is not yet finished with you.
equipment: Choose A or B: (A) 2 Daggers, Thieves' Tools, Gaming Set (any), Bedroll, 2 Pouches, Traveler's Clothes, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP
flavor_tr: Aynı talihsizliğe uğramış kişilerle sokaklarda büyüdünüz; kimi zaman yemek için hırsızlığa başvurdunuz ama gururu ve umudu hiç yitirmediniz. Kader henüz sizinle bitmedi.
equipment_tr: A veya B seçin: (A) 2 Hançer, Hırsız Aletleri, Oyun Seti (herhangi), Uyku Tulumu, 2 Kese, Gezgin Kıyafetleri, 16 AP; veya (B) 50 AP
